entries.title: Live says why the game is not connected
items: FH6 only sends Data Out while you are driving — Live says that instead of Waiting for game
If port 9999 is already in use after an update, the relay retries and Live says Port 9999 blocked
Setup lists TrackSpec-Live.exe, 127.0.0.1, and port 9999

entries.title: Install popup + FH6 spring/ride units
items: Install now downloads the new TrackSpec-Live.exe, replaces this one, and opens it again
Tune Results spring rate is kgf/mm — same number you type in FH6
Ride height is cm, not inches

entries.title: Owned cars keep the Manual details you type
items: I have this car on Manual marks it owned and stores Specs + Build on this device
Pick that car again (search or chip) and you get the last weight, springs, packages, and step
Garage Mark owned does the same — you don’t re-enter the same numbers every tune

entries.title: Save a Manual draft and pick up where you left off
items: Save draft on Manual keeps the car, specs, and which step you were on
Switching to Live or Garage no longer wipes an unfinished Manual
Back from Tune Results returns to the same fields
Drafts restore after a refresh, including cars that are not favorites

entries.title: Touge, Drag, Rally, Cross Country, and Speed on every car
items: Each garage car now has six Track Spec tunes: Track Day, Touge Run, Speed, Drag Run, Rally Stage, Cross Country
Touge: street strip, semi-slicks, splitter when the car has aero
Speed: street strip, semi-slicks, rear wing when the car has aero, long gears for traps
Drag: sport strip, drag radials, no aero
Rally: street strip, chassis brace, rally tires, mixed surface
Cross Country: street strip, chassis brace, rally tires, dirt trails
Load from Garage or Manual. Buy the listed Upgrades parts, then enter the sliders

entries.title: Race build on every car
items: Every garage car has a Track Spec Race tune — Load from Garage or Manual
Stock engine, street strip, race gearbox, semi-slicks, race brakes
Tune Results lists the Upgrades parts to buy first (Race springs, ARBs, trans, clutch, diff, brakes, alignment). Copy/export includes the same list

entries.title: Series 4 cars + patch deps
items: Garage adds Series 4 / Car Pass cars the live list is still missing (N600, Camaro ZL1 '24, Exocet, Celica GT, Starion, 961, Thunderbird, Tipo 33/2, Skyline Turbo RS)
Each new car has a Track Spec Race build (street strip, race gearbox, semi-slicks, race brakes) — Load from Garage or Manual
A later forzagarage.com merge keeps those cars instead of deleting them
Compatible npm patches (Express 4.22, Electron 37.10, Vite 5.4.21, Wrangler 4.124)
List-page 0 mph / hp / lbs is not stored as a real spec

entries.title: Manual upgrades, game limits, favorites
items: Drivetrain conversion, upgrade packages, and stay-in-class PI builder on Manual
Tune values clamp to FH6 slider min/max; results show slider %
Favorite cars (GR86 + 430 Scuderia) keep full Specs + measured Soft/Stiff ends
Garage stock ratings and saved tunes on the Manual Car tab
Ride height min/max on Specs, saved with your spring overrides
Garage refresh from forzagarage.com merges into existing data (622 cars — specs, mastery, photos kept)
Desktop exe checks for updates on launch, downloads the new file, and replaces itself on restart

entries.title: In-app desktop self-update
items: Update button downloads and installs the new exe inside Track Spec
No browser / GitHub page required — restart applies the update
Progress bar while the new build downloads

entries.title: Hardened desktop relay bind on Windows
items: Desktop relay binds 127.0.0.1 and falls back to an OS-picked free port
Electron waits on a real listen promise instead of only /ping polling
Error dialog now includes the relay.log tail for diagnosis

entries.title: Fix desktop exe relay not starting
items: Retry ports on Windows EACCES (excluded port ranges), not only EADDRINUSE
Desktop shell prefers ports 39200+ to avoid clashes with :3000
Writable session data + relay.log under AppData
Open the app offline if the relay still cannot bind (Live disabled)
Fully exit on close (no leftover Track Spec process holding ports)
Fix build using stale App.jsx so Garage, Sessions, and Update appear

entries.title: Fix desktop exe port-in-use crash
items: Reuse an already-running Track Spec relay instead of crashing
Fall back to ports 3001–3009 when 3000 is busy
Stop the Electron “Uncaught Exception” dialog for EADDRINUSE
WebSocket follows the UI port when the relay serves the app

entries.title: Fix desktop exe black screen
items: Wait for the local relay before opening the UI
Electron always opens the app (not the marketing page)
Disable service workers in the desktop shell
Clearer errors if port 3000 is already in use

entries.title: Live timing suite + Update button
items: Dedicated Update button in the sidebar and mobile header
Live timing sheet with top speed per lap
Best times by class and by car (with cars used)
Track labels, stint summary, CSV/PNG export
Class ghost delta and live PB alerts
Loaded tune linked to the active session

entries.title: Desktop Live exe, light phone pack, update center
items: TrackSpec-Live.exe — double-click for UI + Live relay
Cloudflare light pack (~11 MB) with garage thumbs
Faster Garage: windowed list, slim JSON, deferred images
Drive icons fixed (front/rear axles)
In-app update checker and full changelog

entries.title: Garage performance + Cloudflare deploy
items: Slim forzaGarage-list.json for mobile
Scroll windowing so phones don’t mount 622 cards
Cloudflare Workers static deploy config
PWA refresh button (no re-add to Home Screen)

entries.title: Tuning tools + data refresh
items: Quick Tune / Manual flows with garage specs
Engine swaps from Forza Wiki
Save, share, compare tunes locally
Metric / Imperial units
Live HUD and car detect prompts

entries.title: Track Spec launch
items: FH6 tuning calculator PWA
Garage browser with mastery and collection
Live telemetry relay (UDP 9999)
Theme and design settings
